methods.interpretation: All 48 rows returned for exact Chinese registrant 乐普医学电子仪器股份有限公司; 4 pages (15/15/15/3). Single-registrant current snapshot, not all Chinese manufacturers or a historical registry census.
Every returned unique DI included after list/JSON model matching and 14-field HTML/JSON matching. No product excluded because it is external equipment; component_role separates it from implants.

UDI first-publication/version dates are not approval or renewal dates. Rows first published in June 2026 are explicitly outside the February 2024 review snapshot. Older first-publication dates do not prove that current fields were identical in 2024.

Read registry product names and descriptions; screen explicit Chinese/English AI and ML terminology. No trained-model mechanism established. Software, programming and stimulation alone are not AI evidence. No firmware, IFU or independent algorithm audit.

12 implanted active devices, 19 implanted lead/component rows, 17 external/procedural equipment or accessory rows. Category translations and family labels are curator annotations based on registry names/descriptions; counts are UDI model records, not distinct technologies or implanted patients.

Raw certificate strings retained, including paired number forms. No new current-validity check. Prior provincial cross-check applies only to previously documented product/number pairs, not all 48 models.
All 48 records state no MR safety information in instructions/label; this is not MR Unsafe. Blank retirement and -- listing values do not establish active authorization or availability.
All exports carry the same unified social credit code. Registered English name is retained as supplied; company-role field is registrant/filer, not an inferred manufacturing-site assertion.
Original five-model Qinming files and original US/AI datasets remain intact. Expanded sheets and files are separately named; 43 added model records relative to the five-model seed.
22 copied fields per model have JSON-key provenance. ZIP retains original JSON/HTML/search-response bytes and SHA-256 manifest. Complete official exports are separately packaged as JSON.
